applyTo: "**/*{research,participant,study,ADSS,consent}*"

# Research-Data Safety Instructions

- Do not inspect, open, copy, summarize, transmit, or transform participant records, research exports, direct identifiers, consent records, or production study data.
- Use synthetic or redacted fixtures only; never use real participant data in agent context or tests.
- ADSS is screening and identification only.
- Each participant selects exactly one intervention domain.
- Use one psychological test per domain.
- Preserve the sequence: pre-test -> Session 1 -> Session 2 -> Session 3 -> post-test.
- Do not change research methodology, outcome definitions, intervention structure, or domain mappings without explicit human approval.
- Gita mapping is conceptual and thematic only; do not convert it into clinical claims.
- Do not describe the system as a diagnostic, treatment, or cure system.
- Personalization means structured context and state, not model-weight retraining from participant data.
- Stop and request human direction when a task would require access to protected research data or methodology decisions.
